svg.title: Kafka MirrorMaker 2 High Level Design
svg.desc: Data replication pipeline from primary Kafka cluster to standby via MirrorMaker 2 with data loss and topic reset detection

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Kafka producer work in this project?')
sendPrompt('What is the commit-log topic and why is it important?')
sendPrompt('What custom changes were made to MirrorMaker 2?')
sendPrompt('What is the primary.commit-log topic on the standby cluster?')
sendPrompt('What consumes from primary.commit-log on the standby cluster?')
sendPrompt('How does Scenario 1 normal replication work?')
sendPrompt('How does Scenario 2 data loss detection work?')
sendPrompt('How does Scenario 3 topic reset recovery work?')
sendPrompt('How does MM2 track offsets internally?')
